name: George Padmore
contribution: A leading Pan-Africanist, journalist, and author.
legacy: Nkrumah ranked this person as "one of the greatest architects of the African liberation movement ... dedicated to African union and liberty."

checks.lead: George Padmore (28 June 1903 – 23 September 1959), born Malcolm Ivan Meredith Nurse, was a leading Pan-Africanist, journalist, and author. He left his native Trinidad in 1924 to study medicine in the United States, where he also joined the Communist Party.
